        "All 46 changed paths and every owned hunk were read. Eighteen header pairs move from public to src; exact byte comparison proves that replacing the three guard occurrences is the entire original header-content change. The private per-pair ledger retains old, landed and accepted blob IDs. This is move/guard proof, not a fresh semantic audit of unchanged declarations.",
        "All eight build-file changes and both component-registration changes retain the exported header basenames while moving their source lists. MimeEncoder.h and MimeHeaderParser.h remain in EXPORTS.mozilla.mailnews. Six database and two search registration header paths change to src without changing the owned CID, contract or type entries. Accepted build lists and representative native includes confirm the scoped integration state.",
        "Every accepted header retains the new SRC guard, but all 18 accepted whole blobs differ from their landed counterparts. No whole-current-header equivalence or unchanged-caller claim follows. The current guard snapshots illustrate this exact path scope; the existing obsolete-header deletion and local mbox-helper lessons concern different contracts and are not forced into this relocation.",
        "No tests or assertions change. Static export, registration, include and guard inspection does not establish a successful build, ABI compatibility or all downstream consumers.",
        "Full primary comments 0–2 and the full D282543 timeline/actual inline are reconciled. The author leaves some interface-like headers unmoved, so this is not a universal public-directory rule. The reviewer qualifies cross-module includeability expectations and plans a local check before approval; the rendered discussion does not report that check’s actual result. The retained exports, component paths and scoped includes provide static support without a build or ABI guarantee."
